startUrls.title: Website URLs
startUrls.description: One or more website URLs to scan for contact info (e.g. company homepages).

maxDepth.title: Max crawl depth
maxDepth.description: How many link-hops from each start URL to follow within the same domain (e.g. to reach a Contact or About page). 0 = only scan the start URL itself.

maxPagesPerDomain.title: Max pages per domain
maxPagesPerDomain.description: Safety cap on how many pages to visit per start domain.
